artworks.title: Classical Head in Profile
artworks.medium: graphite and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's head and neck in profile view. The head is drawn facing left, with detailed facial features including a straight nose, full lips, and one eye shaded. The person's hair is styled in a swept-up fashion with wavy locks and a headband, gathered in a bun. The drawing does not include the rest of the body, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Harbor Scene
artworks.medium: brush and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a water-level perspective showing maritime activity. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky and water scene. Distant silhouettes of buildings or fortifications are visible. Various ships of different sizes are depicted, with sails and flags highlighted by watercolor shading. A ship closest to the viewer appears to be firing or smoking on the left side. To the right, figures are pulling a fishing net with a catch. The color palette is primarily gray tones, giving the image an aged appearance, reminiscent of old photographs or sketches, evoking a classic nautical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Rocks and Waterfall
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated position of a narrow cascade of water flowing through large rocks. The horizon is not visible, and the focus is on the rocky terrain and the watercourse. Detailed brushstrokes create texture for the rocks and water. The color palette is sepia, giving a monochromatic and nostalgic quality. Close to us, there are textured rocks with a small stream of water, while in the distance, more rocks and foliage frame the water's path.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape, Stream and Waterfall
artworks.medium: graphite with white (gouache?) on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with a river flowing diagonally towards the viewer and a waterfall in the distance on the upper left. There are trees, rocky formations, and detailed brushstrokes depicting the water and foliage. The color scheme is mainly brown, gray, and white, and trees are densely packed on the right side.

artworks.title: The Hudson at Nyack
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on light brown paper
artworks.description: The image is a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective, looking towards a body of water. The horizon is placed just below the midpoint of the composition, where gentle hills are silhouetted against the sky. Sailing boats can be seen on the water, appearing small and delicate. On the right side of the scene, lush trees and foliage extend from close to us into the distance, creating depth and texture with fine, intricate lines and stippling techniques. The overall color palette is muted, consisting of earthy browns and soft grays. The image is bordered by an oval shape.

artworks.title: Landscape, Early Spring
artworks.medium: graphite touched with white (gouache?) on light brown paper
artworks.description: The image displays a natural scene from a ground-level perspective. A grassy plain is in the foreground, leading to a dense cluster of trees without a clear horizon. Foliage fills the background, with detailed trees rising towards the sky. The artwork uses sketch-like brushstrokes and pencil lines to depict the texture of the trees and vegetation. The color scheme is primarily brown and gray, creating a monochromatic aesthetic that emphasizes texture and shading. The drawing's tranquility is enhanced by its simplicity, line density variations, and depth.

artworks.title: Signature in Palette
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist's signature and an artist's palette. The signature is a swirling line across the center of the page, above a simple illustration of a palette. The palette has a circular outline, spots representing paint blobs, and an extended handle. The signature flows elegantly, suggesting a refined hand. The composition is minimalistic, emphasizing the connection between the signature and the palette.

artworks.title: Partial Sketch of a Boy in Knickers
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist down to their feet. The person is standing with one leg bent at the knee, and their feet close together. The sketch uses faint lines and shading to depict clothing that appears to be a skirt or dress reaching slightly below the knee. The clothing has a flowy texture, with an additional garment or fabric visible. There are no facial features, hair, or arms in the sketch, and the background is blank.

artworks.title: Studies for Elaine
artworks.medium: graphite on blue wove paper
artworks.description: This is a pencil drawing depicting two full-body figures standing side by side. Both figures are shown in profile, facing to the left. The figure on the left stands with arms folded across the chest, wearing a tunic that falls just above the knee. The hair appears to be short and styled in a simple, rounded fashion. The figure on the right also stands with arms crossed but leans slightly forward, with a similar modest hairstyle. This person is also dressed in a knee-length garment, resembling a tunic tied with a belt. Both figures are barefoot. The background is a plain, textured paper with no additional elements or detail. The overall tone of the drawing is minimalist and monochrome.

artworks.title: The Old Soldier - Berncastel
artworks.medium: graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of an older man sitting on a bench. He faces slightly to the right and has a stern expression. The man is wearing a large-brimmed hat, a buttoned coat over a vest, shorts, visible socks, and buckled shoes. He is holding a walking stick in his right hand that rests on the ground, and his left hand rests on his knee. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Lake George
artworks.medium: graphite touched with white (chalk?) on green wovepaper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white drawing of a serene landscape. The viewer's perspective is framed by arching trees, with a low horizon showing distant mountains or hills against a shaded sky. Two small figures stand on a rocky outcrop overlooking a calm body of water. The drawing features delicate and detailed brushstrokes capturing textures and details of the scene. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of grey to depict depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Evening, Farm Landscape
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with clusters of trees and a small structure in the distance. The sky is illuminated by a bright moon with wispy clouds partially covering it. The scene is depicted with subtle brushstrokes and a limited, mostly monochromatic color palette, providing a tranquil atmosphere. The ground appears textured and shadowy in contrast to the illuminated sky.

artworks.title: Seated Girl
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side view portrait of a woman's upper body. She is seated with her body slightly turned away from the viewer and her head facing to the left side of the frame. Her facial features are in shadow, and her hair is tied back. She is dressed in dark clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is shadowy with a dark, textured appearance, suggesting an indoor setting or studio with subdued lighting. The overall use of dark tones creates a moody scene.

artworks.title: Recruit; Two Studies of Heads
artworks.medium: graphite touched with white chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person in profile view facing left. The individual holds a rifle over their right shoulder with their left hand and their right hand is on their belt. They wear a wide-brimmed hat and simple attire. Surrounding the main figure are three close-up side profile sketches of the head from various angles, emphasizing the hat and facial structure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saco, Looking Northwest
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing to the right. A large boulder with a tree is in the foreground, and the horizon is low, just above the distant treeline. The scene is rendered with fine line work and cross-hatching for texture and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray on cream-colored paper.

artworks.title: Character Study
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a full-body sketch of a person standing in a slightly bent-over position, with their weight resting on a surface in front of them. The person has a distinctive facial profile with prominent cheekbones and a slightly downturned mouth, and their hair is hidden beneath a large, furry hat. Their attire is composed of a long, loose-fitting coat with ample fabric that drapes over their body, paired with baggy trousers. They are wearing shoes that are somewhat rounded at the toes. The background of the image is a simple, blank canvas.

artworks.title: The Drinker
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated with most of his body visible. He is leaning back, with one arm resting on a surface and the other holding a glass. His head is slightly tilted to the side, and he has a relaxed expression. The man has short, tousled hair and distinct facial features. He is wearing a jacket with a turned-up collar over a buttoned waistcoat and shirt, along with loose-fitting trousers. The setting is simple, with a plain background that emphasizes the figure.

artworks.title: Irish Fisherman
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man standing with his legs turned slightly to the side. He is leaning forward and appears to be pointing or holding something with his right hand. The man's facial features are detailed, with a thoughtful expression. He has short hair and is wearing a coat, waistcoat, hat, and scarf. He has a strap across his chest holding a cylindrical container and a bag on his left hip. The background is blank, emphasizing the man's attire and posture in this monochromatic drawing.

artworks.title: Man Leaning on a Counter
artworks.medium: black chalk, (black crayon?), and graphite on laidpaper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of an elderly man, shown from head to toe. The man stands in a leaning position with crossed arms on a slightly inclined surface. Details of age are seen in his face, with distinct lines and curly hair. He is dressed in a long coat, loose-fitting trousers, and lace-up shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Unknown Yale Student
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on bristol board
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man. He is positioned slightly turned to his left while facing the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, sideburns, and short curly hair. He is dressed in early 19th-century attire, including a dark coat with a high collar, a white shirt, and a black cravat. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain with a subtle gradient effect. The portrait is encircled by an oval outline.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing showing the head and upper chest of a person in a three-quarter profile. The person has closed eyes, finely detailed facial features, neat hair pulled back with a textured band, and is wearing a high-collared garment. The background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Seated Study of M.D.
artworks.medium: graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a man seated in a chair, shown in a side profile position with most of his body visible and legs crossed. His left hand rests on his knee while his right arm is bent with a fist. The man has defined facial features, a beard, sideburns, and curly, combed-back hair. He is dressed in a suit with a vest and tie and holds a top hat in his left hand. The background is plain. The initials "N.D." are written in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch portrait of a man, showing his head and a portion of his upper torso. He is positioned with his head turned slightly to his right, directly engaging the viewer with his gaze. The man's facial features include a defined brow, deep-set eyes with detailed lashes, a prominent nose, and a thick mustache. His hair is wavy and brushed back, giving a refined appearance. He is wearing a collared garment, possibly a shirt or coat, as indicated by the lines near his neck. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands. The background is a plain, unadorned canvas that highlights the focus on the man's visage and expression.

artworks.title: The Young Doctor
artworks.medium: charcoal with black and white chalk on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man. He is facing slightly to the right and has his left arm resting on a surface. The man has short, curly hair and distinct cheekbones. He is wearing a double-breasted jacket with wide lapels over a white shirt with a high collar and a dark cravat. The background is dark-toned, emphasizing the man's features, with subtle shading for depth.
